strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Computer, lock off. Program number THX139.
The keyword is...
So this is... the Dragon. It was a battleship.
Amazing... I've heard the rumors.
A giant dragon that always led the front against Muge in the last war...
So that wasn't a metaphor. It really is shaped like this.
With this... we won't lose so easily.
(If the Dragon's heart... can hold out to the end, that is.)
Heh, been a while, Gandor! All right, Dancougar's launching too!
Well, Commander, we'll head on up to space ahead of you.
Wait, Yuki. We'll launch from the Space Science Laboratory.
Stand by until then.
Dancougar can make it to space on its own, you know, Commander.
I told you, the adjustments aren't complete.
Right now, Dancougar has only about 50% of its normal capability.
Seriously? Man, that's a sad story.
Enemy attack!?
Of all the timing...! All units, sortie!
Hoh, they still had a warship this size hidden. Can't take them lightly.
Is that... a Gouf...? No, it's a custom type.
Hm... Why does the Federation have a Zaku...? It seems heavily tuned...
That type is... if I recall, from the Cyclops Team...
I'd heard there was a traitor...
Zaku pilot! Captain Steiner would weep!
Bernie...
...I just chose the path I believe is right!
Hah! That's the spirit!
Then you're ready to be shot down by your former comrades...!!
Wiseman! Focus on the battle! Don't let the enemy's words get to you!
Yes, sir!
Sounds like there's some kind of story here, but I don't give a damn!
We just smash the enemy and push on! Let's do this!
Hold it right there, Shinobu!
Just 'cause they're mobile suits doesn't mean you can run wild!
What're you talking about, Sara? Dancougar doesn't lose to anybody!
Idiot! Obviously it's better to fight on favorable terrain!
Dancougar is suited to ground combat. Especially my Iron Fist.
Our ammo and energy are limited...
and you always forget, but beam weapons are weak in water, Shinobu.
Shut up! I know that already!
Bernie, stay close to me and I'll give you proper cover.
...Thanks, Chris.
If we get the chance, we'll launch a simultaneous attack!
Keep an eye on the formation as much as you can, Nanbu!
Roger!
I'll back you up with the repair device, but don't push yourselves, everyone!
None of our units are good in water... Everyone!
Mind your machines' capabilities and get through this!
Nngh, to think they'd go this far...! Retreating!
Take the skill / Don't take the skill
Cleared within the turn limit. Acquired skill "Resolve".
You're not getting away!
Nanbu! Don't pursue too far!
Dammit, they wreck our start and then just get away...
They get in our way, and then they just run off!?
You could also call it a masterful withdrawal.
It's not over yet. Don't let your guard down.
...Ready to be shot by my own comrades... huh.
We managed to drive them off.
True... right now, Dancougar's response
and firepower are both below par.
Don't neglect maintenance. If you go to space and can't stand up
to the Vega Star Federation, there's no point in sending you.
Leave it to us, Commander.
We don't wanna be laughed at by the Londo Bell members either.
All right, everyone, listen up as you are.
Word just came from the Saotome and Photon Power Laboratories.
They say they'll lend us a hand.
Huh! No way...
Yes, that's exactly it.
The super robots of the last war will lend us their strength...!
